map.blurb: Map comfort: teams and individuals who are strong or weak here.

agent.blurb: Agent comfort, including players forced onto agents they are bad with.

map_agent.blurb: The interaction on its own -- fine on the map, fine on the agent, special together.

shrinkage.blurb: Small samples versus large ones. A 3-game streak should not outweigh 500 games.

form.blurb: Hot and cold streaks, and streaks that contradict a career record.

rust.blurb: Time since last played, from today to months idle.

experience.blurb: Account age and games played, deliberately separated from skill.

composition.blurb: Team compositions: missing roles, stacked roles, balance versus raw skill.

off_role.blurb: Players on agents outside the role they normally play.

party.blurb: Queue structure, from five solos to a full five-stack.

distribution.blurb: Same average strength, different shape -- one star versus five even players.

coverage.blurb: How many players we actually have history for, including none at all.

contradiction.blurb: Signals that disagree. Real matches rarely point one way.

boundary.blurb: Extreme but legal values -- 0% and 100% rates, rank floors and ceilings.

dominance.blurb: One side better on essentially everything, in graded amounts.

cancellation.blurb: Advantages deliberately set to offset each other.
